label: Cells as charges, density as energy
section: Cells as charges, density as energy
subgoals: Assign each cell a charge equal to its area
Compute the potential from Poisson's equation
Take half the sum of charge times potential as the penalty

label: Density force as electric force
subgoals: Express the density gradient as charge times electric field
Compute the force magnitude from the field components
Precondition by pin count plus lambda times charge

label: Fillers and the overflow target
subgoals: Compute the filler area as target density times free area minus movable area
Divide by the filler size for the filler count
